action.name: report
action.content: SELECT iso_code, year, electricity_generation AS generation_twh FROM energy WHERE (iso_code = 'DNK' OR iso_code = 'FIN') AND year >= 2019 AND year <= 2022 AND electricity_generation IS NOT NULL ORDER BY iso_code, year

action.name: coverage
action.content: SELECT iso_code, count(year) AS observed_years, sum(CASE WHEN electricity_generation IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_generation_years FROM energy WHERE (iso_code = 'DNK' OR iso_code = 'FIN') AND year >= 2019 AND year <= 2022 GROUP BY iso_code ORDER BY iso_code
